title: UniVidX: Unified Multimodal Video Diffusion Framework
summary: A unified 'any-to-any' video diffusion framework designed for 15+ tasks including video matting, relighting, and inverse rendering. It treats various modalities like RGB, depth, and alpha as interchangeable conditions or targets within a single architecture.
research_notes: Built on the Wan2.1 backbone using Stochastic Condition Masking and Decoupled Gated LoRA to maintain consistency across modalities with minimal training data.

evolution.summary: Officially released in May 2026 and accepted for SIGGRAPH 2026. The framework debuted with two specialized models: UniVid-Intrinsic for physical properties and UniVid-Alpha for layer decomposition.
